sn12.15:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Kaccāyanagotto yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam nisīdi || 3 Ekam antām nisinno kho āyasmā Kaccāyanagotto Bhagavantam etad avoca ||
sn12.15:1.4: kittāvatā nu kho bhante sammādiṭṭhi hotīti || || 4
sn12.15:2.1: Dvayanissito khvāyaṃ Kaccāyana loko yebhuyyena atthitañ ceva natthitañ ca || 5
sn12.15:2.2: Lokasamudayaṃ kho Kaccāyana yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato yā loke natthitā sā na hoti ||
sn12.15:2.3: lokanirodhaṃ kho Kaccāyana yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato yā loke atthitā sā na hoti || || 6
sn12.15:2.5: tañcāyaṃ upāyupādānām cetaso adhiṭṭhānam abhinivesānusayaṃ na upeti na upādiyati nādhiṭṭhāti attā na me ti ||
sn12.15:2.6: Dukkham eva uppajjamānam uppajjati dukkhaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ nirujjhatīti na kaṅkhati na vicikicchati aparapaccayā ñāṇam evassa ettha hoti || ||
sn12.15:3.1: Sabbam atthīti kho Kaccāyana ayam eko anto ||
sn12.15:3.3: Ete te Kaccāyana ubho ante anupagamma majjhena Tathāgato dhammam deseti || || 8
sn12.15:3.6: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || ||
sn12.15:3.9: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotīti || ||
